scoring_justification: T1 recompute of the full simulation is not feasible within the lightweight checker; the paper's headline claims are best captured by structural verification of cluster distribution features (peak at formation sizes, tail direction inversion with temperature) and the qualitative ordering of diffusion coefficients, which are decisive products of the model.

outputs.description: Cluster size distribution at 1 and 5 dpa for temperatures 600, 650, 660 K. Scored on structural features such as peak position and the relative extent of tail toward larger sizes for interstitials vs vacancies at different temperatures.

Total, vacancy, and interstitial diffusion coefficients at 5 dpa for temperatures 500 and 660 K. The checker verifies the temperature-dependent ordering of vacancy and interstitial diffusion, and that magnitudes are physically plausible.

output_contract.notes: All parameters are taken from the paper's Tables 1 and 2. The simulation is the heavy part; the agent must implement the full model including the Brailsford-Bullough effective medium sink calculation. The scored outputs are derived from the simulation; no external datasets are used.

steps.description: Interstitial cluster size distributions must peak at the cascade formation size n=10.
At low temperature (600 K) interstitials dominate the distribution tail; at high temperature (660 K) vacancies dominate, as expected from the model.
Diffusion coefficient ordering must be D_i > D_v at 500 K and D_v > D_i at 660 K, with physically plausible magnitudes.
